cc:Work.dc:title: A Minor Guitar Chord at the Open Position

cc:Agent.dc:title: Created with CutyCapt by Björn Höhrmann

rdf:Bag.rdf:li: A Minor Guitar Chord, A Minor chord, Am chord, Amin chord, A- chord

cc:Work.dc:description: Your first finger goes on the first fret of the second string. Your second finger goes on the second fret of the fourth string. Your third finger goes on the second fret of the third string. The first and fifth strings are open. The sixth string is muted.
